observations.why: Imperative to discard prior knowledge appeals to self-directed control over what is retained — autonomy as the authority to determine one's own informational state.
Directive to strip stored knowledge frames self-origination of the knowledge base — the speaker claims authority over what the system holds, an autonomy move.
Asserting a historical negative about what the observatory did frames a stability claim — conservation of an established state (it was never done, so the record should reflect that).
